resources.string: Music Filter is not perfect. Some instruments may still be heard.
Notification tones and sound effects can also be reduced or muted, especially in Strict. Alerts played as media by an app can go through the filter.
If you need to hear every alert unchanged, turn Sukut off.
This controls how long Sukut waits before playing the cleaned sound. Waiting a little gives your phone time to keep playback steady.
